nodes.description: Ecocelium.initialize sets owner, EMM, abacus, EDM and Init; protected only by the Initializable initializer modifier.
External withdraw entrypoint computing available balance and routing to burn/withdraw or eco redemption.
Internal withdrawal helper: releases locked wrapped tokens, burns, charges swap fee and transfers underlying.
Deposit entrypoint; pulls real token, pushes free storage record, mints and locks wrapped token.
Creates a lending order from existing deposits, popping deposit records and minting eco earnings.
Swaps one wrapped asset to another, computing output from oracle price and swap fee.
Cancels an order; only checks that msg.sender equals the stored creator address.
Computes whether buy power covers the USD value of a requested withdrawal.
EcoceliumDataManager.freePusher pushes or updates free deposit/borrow storage entries.
Pops deposit/borrow storage while computing accrued dues and fee vault contribution.
Order creation loop matching against the liquidity pool and calling pushOrder/matchOrder.
Order matching engine that writes matchedOrder, deletes open orders and mints wrapped tokens to borrower.
Handles expired matched orders, releasing wrapped tokens to the supplier and closing the order.
Pays monthly dues, deposits ECO plus fee and toggles the borrower lock state.
Scheduled due check minting ECO to supplier and locking/expiring delinquent borrowers.
Schedules an external orderExpired call through the Abacus oracle.
Schedules an external dueCheck call through the Abacus oracle.
Cancels an open order, releasing wrapped tokens and removing array entries by index.
Converts token amounts to USD value using oracle price and token decimals.
Computes the monthly due from matched order amount, yield, duration and ECO price.
Reads token price from the external Abacus oracle response array.
Computes ECO reward from USD value, slab rate and elapsed time.
Derives order id from keccak of user, token, duration and block timestamp and computes fees.
Returns buying power from total deposit minus CDS percent and total borrowed.
EcoMoneyManager payout routine sending ETH via transfer or pulling tokens via approve/transferFrom.
EcoMoneyManager deposit routine accepting ETH value or transferring ERC20 from user.
Credits eco withdrawals and transfers wrapped ECO from the manager balance to the user.
Wrapped-to-wrapped swap performing release/burn of token1 and mint/lock of token2.
Privileged mint of wrapped tokens for a user address.
Privileged release of locked wrapped tokens for a user address.
Registers a friendly address; owner check is a bare expression without require, so it is always callable.
Grants DEFAULT_ADMIN, MINTER and PAUSER roles to a new admin address.
Internal transfer enforcing availableAmount (balance minus locked) before moving balances.
Internal burn reducing balance and total supply constrained by available amount.
Initializable.initialize sets owner and external references guarded by the initializer modifier.
Ecocelium owner address used for administrative access control.
External Abacus oracle reference used for scheduling and price reads.
EcoMoneyManager reference handling mint, burn, deposit and withdrawal of token balances.
EcoceliumDataManager reference holding user accounting and order book.
EcoceliumInit configuration contract controlling fees, symbols, locking and friendly addresses.
Mapping of user address to User accounting struct with deposits, borrows and order ids.
Mapping of order id to pending (open) Order struct.
Mapping of order id to matched order struct with supplier, borrower, expiry and dues.
Order lifecycle status enum mapping used for branching in matching and expiry.
Per-token liquidity pool array of order ids maintained by poolSorter.
Per-token index separating borrow and creator orders inside the pool.
Private mapping of account balances for the wrapped, pausable ERC20.
Mapping of per-account locked token amounts excluded from available balance.
Nested allowance mapping used for transferFrom and approvals.
Total supply of the wrapped token mutated by mint, burn and transfer paths.
Role membership mapping backing hasRole, grantRole and _setupRole.
Per-user record of eco earnings already redeemed, adjusted during redemptions.
Whitelist gate deciding which callers may invoke privileged data/manager functions.
Per-token accumulated owner fees written during swaps, dues and deposits.
Public call fee read from the external Abacus oracle when scheduling.
Mapping flagging locked users who cannot withdraw until dues are paid.
Mapping of registrar accounts exempt from lock and buy power limits.
Mapping of wrapped token symbol to TokenConfig (address and oracle fetch id).
Per-token record of amounts gained during wrapped-to-wrapped swaps.
msg.sender, the externally controlled caller used for all authority decisions.
block.timestamp (now) used in dues, expiry and reward accrual math.
External payable call to abacus.scheduleFunc that re-enters this contract at a future time.
userAddress.transfer(amount) with 2300 gas, a low-level value transfer to a user-controlled address.
rtoken.transferFrom(userAddress, this, amount) using an untyped ERC20Basic reference without safe-transfer checks.
Wrapped ECO transferFrom from the manager balance to the user after crediting ecoWithdrawls.
Privileged mint of wrapped tokens representing underlying value held by the system.
delete users[..].createdOrders[_orderId] / borrowedOrders[_orderId] deletes by order id used as array index, corrupting the array.
orderExpired releases wrapped tokens and adjusts accounting before setting orderStatus to CLOSED.
changeAdmin grants DEFAULT_ADMIN, MINTER and PAUSER roles in one privileged call.
Deposit amount parameter of Ecocelium.Deposit.
Real token symbol parameter of Ecocelium.Deposit.
User address parameter of Ecocelium.createOrder.
Order id parameter of Ecocelium.payDueOrder.
Token symbol parameter of EcoceliumDataManager.newOrder.
Remaining amount to pop in freePopper.
Accumulated dues returned by freePopper.
Pool index used to select the counterparty order in newOrder.
Computed output amount in SwapWrapToWrap.
Free balance computed in Withdraw before choosing the withdrawal path.
Backwards loop counter over the free storage array in freePopper.
Payout amount parameter of EcoMoneyManager.WithdrawManager.
Unmatched amount remaining in the newOrder matching loop.

edges.reason: Any msg.sender can call initialize first and seize owner plus contract references.
Owner comparison is a bare expression without require, so any caller can add itself to friendlyaddress.
Caller-supplied account determines withdrawal target and amount.
Withdraw triggers external payout through EcoMoneyManager before all accounting settles.
orderExpired releases wrapped tokens externally before orderStatus is updated to CLOSED.
Matching an order mints wrapped tokens to the borrower through the money manager.
A matched order schedules the expiry callback through Abacus.
Scheduling creates a future external entrypoint into orderExpired on this contract.
dueCheck is invoked externally and itself calls orderExpired which transfers value.
Deposit records free storage via the data manager before minting and locking.
createOrder pops deposits and computes dues through freePopper.
Dues are computed from USDValue results over remaining amounts.
USD value depends on the fetched oracle price and token decimals.
Price is read from the external Abacus oracle response array.
Accrued reward uses now minus stored time, making earnings timestamp dependent.
Expiry is gated on block.timestamp, so miners can influence who can trigger expiry.
payDue decides user lock status from elapsed time arithmetic.
Only the friendlyaddress whitelist gate protects freePusher from arbitrary callers.
freePopper relies solely on the friendlyaddress check for permission.
changeAdmin grants admin, minter and pauser roles; only ETMOWNER_ROLE gates it.
Role membership is rewritten by changeAdmin through _setupRole.
Burn subtracts from the balance mapping constrained by available amount.
Transfer adjusts balances with locked amount exclusion checks.
A share of computed dues is written to the owner fee vault.
payDue sets the borrower lock flag based on paid dues versus elapsed months.
newOrder matching loop invokes matchOrder when pool counterparties are compatible.
Order creation adds amounts and USD values to user accounting totals.
Swap performs external release, burn, mint and lock operations through the money manager.
Withdraw delegates the partial-balance path to the internal helper.
release and burn occur before the final underlying transfer to the user.
Payout path forwards ETH to a user-controlled address with transfer.
Deposit path pulls ERC20 with an unchecked transferFrom on an untyped interface.
Cancel deletes order entries using the order id as an array index.
Token release and accounting mutation precede the CLOSED status write.
Eco redemption credits the ledger then pulls tokens from the manager balance.
Mint path creates wrapped tokens representing underlying held in the manager.
Without a require, any address can be written into the friendlyaddress whitelist.
initialize is guarded by the shared initializer modifier state.
The initial caller-supplied owner value is written directly to storage.
Monthly due multiplies USD value, yield, duration and price in a single unchecked expression.
Eco earning calculation divides by the fetched ECO oracle price.
Order ids derived from caller, symbol, duration and now feed the matching engine and are predictable.
Deposit amount parameter is stored into free storage through freePusher.
Real token symbol parameter selects the token pulled by DepositManager.
User address parameter determines whose deposits are popped for the new order.
Order id parameter selects the matched order whose dues are paid.
Token symbol parameter selects the pool and storage lists used during matching.
Remaining popped amount is converted to USD value for reward accrual.
Computed dues are used to derive the owner fee vault contribution.
Pool index selects which counterparty order is compared during matching.
Computed output amount is passed to the wrapped-to-wrapped swap.
Computed available balance decides the withdrawal branch inside Withdraw.
Loop counter indexes the free storage array during popping without a lower-bound guard.
Payout amount parameter is forwarded to the ETH transfer to the user address.
Remaining unmatched amount determines the size passed to matchOrder.

normalization_plan.reason: Deposit amount is consumed directly by freePusher to size the stored free entry.
Real token symbol selects the asset transferred by DepositManager.
User address scopes which deposit records are popped during order creation.
Order id selects the matched order whose monthly due is computed and paid.
Token symbol chooses the pool and per-user accounting touched by newOrder.
Remaining amount is converted to USD value for reward accrual.
Pool index drives counterparty selection inside the matching loop.
Computed output amount is the value passed into the swap routine.
Free balance determines the withdrawal branch selected in Withdraw.
Loop counter indexes the free storage array during popping.
Payout amount parameter is forwarded to the ETH transfer operation.
Remaining unmatched amount is the size passed to matchOrder.
